name: SwiftUI design system and components
description: A reusable SwiftUI theme and accessible component kit, included by default in planned apps and driven by the plan's design direction and palette.
statusNote: Built into a minimal app with Xcode 27.0 (27A266a) on 2026-10-09.
usage: Use AppTheme spacing, radii and dynamic text styles when composing planned screens. Reuse AppCard for grouped content, HeroHeader for the primary screen title, AppStatTile for key metrics, AppChip for filters/status, AppSectionHeader for hierarchy, AppProgressRing for progress, AppEmptyStateView for genuine empty states, ThumbnailPlaceholder for image-free art direction, and AppPrimaryButtonStyle for primary actions. Read AppColor tokens from the asset catalog. Match the approved plan's mood, typography, shape, density and motion; do not use List/Form as the default layout for feature screens.
